newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Radex plans joint venture with Sohmen.
newsitem.headline: Radex plans joint venture with Sohmen.

text.p: Austria's Radex-Heraklith Industriebeteiligungs AG (RHI) said on Tuesday it plans to join forces with Hong Kong-based shipping magnate Helmut Sohmen.
RHI chief executive Walter Ressler said both RHI and Sohmen would have a 50 percent share in the new company, but added talks had just begun and there were therefore no concrete plans as yet.

RHI will continue focusing on its core interests in the insulation and fireproof materials industry. "However, RHI should not stand still. We have to look to the future and discuss with a partner how best to expand", Ressler said.
The new company will not go public and RHI will not increase its share capital in order to finance the project.
Austrian-born Sohmen is chairman of the World-Wide Group. -- Gabriele Kolar, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 276
